text:
While backpacking Thailand I found myself in Chiang mai and wanting to use some of my time to fill in some big cavities I had in my bottom molars and get a general complete thorough clean of my whole mouth, too.

I'm always nervous going to the dentist anywhere, especially after I had a period of dental neglect. I just want to let anyone who is thinking of having their teeth done in Chiang Mai that this dental clinic is WONDERFUL.

The dentist, Jean or Jin (sorry, I don't know how it is spelt) couldn't be nicer and more sensitive to your comfort and needs. She is clearly passionate about what she does and is very gentle and caring in general. As a huge plus she speaks good English as well!

She informs you along the way as to what she is doing, seeing and thinking. She told me up front what I would be paying and there were no hidden costs or any rush to get you out. She even gave me some tips on dental maintenance and a free roll of floss to apply the knowledge given.

The prices were as far as my research tells me, some of the cheapest in Chiang Mai.

I highly recommend this clinic to everyone.

THANK YOU SO MUCH 🙏 I Couldn't be happier. I wish you the best.
